entries.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_PROFILE_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.description: The numeric id of the Business Profile account whose locations Brain A reads, the digits after accounts/. Not a secret.
howToGet: The account id is the number in the account's resource name, accounts/{id}, which the Business Profile APIs return for the account that manages the store's locations.

entries.name: GOOGLE_BUSINESS_PROFILE_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from connecting a Google account that manages the store's locations, with the business.manage scope only. Google offers no read-only scope for these APIs; the client only reads. It uses the same OAuth client as the other Google connectors but is a separate connection, because each connector stops if its token holds any scope beyond its own.
howToGet: The Google Cloud project that owns the OAuth client needs Business Profile API access, which Google approves on request, with the Business Information, My Business and Business Profile Performance APIs turned on.
Have a manager of the locations connect to the instance's OAuth client with access_type=offline, prompt=consent and only the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage.
The connector stops if the token holds anything else, so don't add other scopes.
Copy the refresh token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
